title: Midnight Garden
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We chased the daylight down the coast
I found a melody in the rain

[Chorus]
We rise like smoke into the blue
Hold the night, don't let it go

[Verse 2]
I found a melody in the rain
We chased the daylight down the coast

[Chorus]
We rise like smoke into the blue
Hold the night, don't let it go

[Outro]
The music never fades away
structure: Intro (4 bars) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Bridge (8) / Chorus (16) / Outro (4)
desc: A bright techno song at 120 BPM in C# major, written by the Signature song engine.
